findings.title: Reflected XSS via unescaped request.referer in inline script
findings.body: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` line 11, `request.referer` is interpolated directly into a JavaScript string literal: `parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>');`. Although `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` checks that `URI(request.referer).host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, the path, query string, or fragment of the Referer URL can still contain single quotes, `</script>`, or JavaScript code (depending on the client/browser sending the Referer header or unencoded characters accepted by Ruby's `URI`). Because ERB HTML-escapes `'` as `'` or leaves characters that break out of `<script>` contexts, or if `raw` / JS escaping is not used, an attacker can break out of the JS string or `<script>` tag and execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Discourse origin. Use `.to_json` or `escape_javascript` (`j`) instead.

findings.title: Raw HTML cook_method bypasses sanitization, enabling stored XSS from RSS feeds
findings.body: In `app/models/post.rb` line 133, `Post#cook` returns `raw` untouched when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` lines 35-36) unescapes HTML from RSS/Atom feed items (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import`, which creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` without any HTML sanitization (unlike `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which runs `Readability::Document` with a tag/attribute whitelist). Any `<script>`, `<iframe>`, or `onerror`/`onload` attributes in the RSS feed (or added when a staff user edits a `raw_html` post) will be stored in `cooked` and rendered unescaped to all forum users (`<%= raw post.cooked %>`).

findings.title: Invalid Ruby syntax `end if` causes SyntaxError when rendering best.html.erb
findings.body: Line 6 of `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` has `<%- end if %>`. In Ruby, `end if` is not valid syntax to close an `if` block (unlike VB); ERB compiles this to `end if;` which raises a `SyntaxError` whenever `embed/best` is rendered for an existing topic.

findings.title: NoMethodError in PollFeed when RSS items use `description` instead of `content`
findings.body: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` line 35, `i.content.scrub` assumes `i.content` is non-nil. In standard RSS 2.0 feeds parsed by `SimpleRSS`, items typically populate `description` (or `content_encoded`) rather than `content` (which is an Atom construct), so `i.content` is `nil` and calling `.scrub` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass`, aborting the entire feed poll job.
